theme_strategy.rationale: Strictly adhering to the requested minimalist light theme. High-contrast dark text on clean white surfaces, with subtle borders and restrained accents for a calm, professional feel.

rules: DO NOT use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Always apply tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter) for headings > 32px.
Overlines/Labels must use uppercase, tiny text, and wide spacing.
Use mono font (JetBrains Mono) for data, telemetry readouts, batch IDs, and numerical dashboards.
Apply colors functionally: #059669 ONLY for Genuine/Safe/In-Stock/Verified. #DC2626 ONLY for Counterfeit, Recalls, Anomalies, and Low Stock.
NO generic full-screen gradients. Use matte, flat surfaces.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for overlays, headers, or dropdowns. Use solid white or slate-50.

surfaces: Flat white panels with subtle 1px slate-200 borders.
Minimal borders, no shadows, no glows.
shadows: No soft shadows. Use 1px solid strokes or flat surfaces.
No transparency overlays. Use solid backgrounds.

spacing_system.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Clean, airy layouts with breathing room.

grids.dashboard_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Use col-span-2 or col-span-3 for main charts.
grids.landing_split: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 min-h-screen. Left: Pharmacy Portal, Right: Patient Trust Hub. Full height.

header_and_logo.description: Clean white sticky navigation bar with inline SVG logo and brand text.
header_and_logo.logo_specs: Build an inline <svg> replacing generic icons. Specifications: 4 camera viewfinder/scanner corner brackets framing a central vertical medical capsule. Top half of capsule has vertical barcode lines. Bottom half is solid with a cut-out checkmark. Render in slate-900 (#0F172A) on the white header.
header_and_logo.typography: Next to logo: 'KYRENIS' in bold slate-900 (Cabinet Grotesk), tagline 'SCAN-VERIFY-TRUST' below it in smaller slate-500.

landing_gateway.description: Split screen layout. Two massive interactive zones. Left: Pharmacy Portal (clean, structural). Right: Patient Trust Hub (approachable but secure).

auth_gateway.description: Centered clean card. Include 'Autofill Test Credentials' button prominently in white with slate border.

tabs.stock_intake: Form with visual 2D DataMatrix QR Output, OCR Text inputs, and DistributorNode selector.
tabs.pos_simulator: Checkout interface showing FIFO deduction logic in real-time.
tabs.replenishment: Governance panel. Highlight expiring items (60 days) in amber/crimson. Big 'Auto-Generate PO' action.
tabs.telemetry: Dashboard with Volumetric Saturation & Spatial Teleportation charts. Use Recharts. Show crimson anomaly banners.

tabs.batch_authenticator: Massive input area leading to a Giant Green Shield (Safe) or Red Warning Shield (Counterfeit).
tabs.openfda_directory: Accordion or dense grid of warnings, adverse_reactions, and dosage panels.

icons_and_assets.library: lucide-react (or @phosphor-icons-react for dense technical grids if added).

landing_bg.description: Dark cybersecurity network / operator - use at low opacity (10-20%) as a background texture for the landing page or auth gateway.

pharmacy_abstract.description: Clean glass test tubes / laboratory. Can be used as a subtle visual for the Pharmacy Portal side of the landing page.

icons_and_assets.rules: Never use placeholder images. If no image fits, use pure CSS typography and layouts.

rules: No 'transition-all'. Target specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Hover states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and highlight border color.
Interactive feedback: Use scale down on click (active:scale-95).

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='pos-checkout-btn').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against white or slate-50 meets high contrast ratios. Use the provided slate-900 and slate-600.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have a sharp 2px outline in slate-300 or slate-900.

libraries.ui: lucide-react, shadcn/ui components (heavily customized to match clean minimalist aesthetic, flat surfaces, subtle borders)

universal_agent_guidelines: DO NOT build a generic SaaS app. This is Kyrenis, an OS with a strict, minimalist light identity.
Implement the custom inline SVG logo EXACTLY as described in the requirements.
Avoid cluttered aesthetics. Use flat white surfaces, subtle 1px borders, and restrained accents.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and JetBrains Mono for data/technical readouts.
Ensure the telemetry dashboard actually visualizes 'Volumetric Saturation' and 'Spatial Teleportation' using charts (Recharts) with clean slate and red accents.
Do NOT center align the app container. Maintain a robust left-aligned grid hierarchy.
Include `data-testid` on all buttons, forms, tabs, and critical status indicators.
